slides.texte_overlay:
1. Your brain remembers
unfinished tasks better than
finished ones. That's why they
keep you up at night.

2. People notice your mistakes
far less than you think.
Everyone is busy
with their own.

3. Smiles are contagious.
People tend to smile back
without even deciding to.

4. Sleep helps your brain
lock in what you learned
that day.

5. A short walk can make
your thinking more creative
than sitting still.

6. We tend to like people
who are similar to us.
Shared interests open doors.

7. Learning a little every day
sticks better than cramming
it all at once.
